title: The Park Bylaw of Avalon (invented)
about: An invented bylaw of an invented borough, after H. L. A. Hart's example of a rule that forbids vehicles in a park (1958, Positivism and the separation of law and morals, Harvard Law Review 71). Every word of it is made up for the example.

provisions.label: Section 1(1)
provisions.text: No vehicle may be taken into the park.

provisions.label: Section 1(2)
provisions.text: Subsection (1) does not apply to a vehicle used in an emergency.

provisions.label: Section 2
provisions.text: A person who takes into the park anything that subsection 1(1) forbids commits an offence.
